about: The asset map: one entry per supplied photograph, with its label, chapter, placement, captions and focal points. Every entry is published. `npm run images` adds new files with status "unreviewed"; give them a chapter, captions and status "approved". See MEMORIES.md.

photos.tentativeIdentity: Messi in Argentina’s dark-blue 2014 away shirt looking at the World Cup trophy on its plinth as he passes it.
photos.verifiedEvent: After the 2014 World Cup final, Germany 1–0 Argentina (a.e.t.), Maracanã, 13 July 2014. Verified from the trophy on its presentation plinth and the away kit Argentina wore in that final.
photos.preferredCrop: Near square. Keep his eyes and the whole trophy.

caption.en: After the World Cup final, Maracanã, 13 July 2014.
caption.es: Después de la final del Mundial, Maracaná, 13 de julio de 2014.

alt.en: Lionel Messi, in Argentina’s dark-blue shirt, looks sideways at the gold World Cup trophy standing on a plinth an arm’s length away.
alt.es: Lionel Messi, con la camiseta azul oscura de Argentina, mira de reojo la Copa del Mundo dorada, apoyada en un pedestal a un brazo de distancia.

photos.notes: The copy supplied has been desaturated by an editor. It is shown as supplied.
photos.usage: Supplied by the site owner. Where the file came from and who holds the rights were not recorded. Not cleared for publication.

photos.tentativeIdentity: Messi on Ronaldinho’s back, celebrating at the Camp Nou in the 2004–05 Barcelona shirt (LFP sleeve patch, no shirt sponsor). Opponents in white. Consistent with the celebration of his first senior goal, v Albacete, 1 May 2005.
photos.preferredCrop: 4:5. Keep the raised hand and both faces.

caption.en: Messi on Ronaldinho’s back at the Camp Nou, 2004–05 season. Widely published as the celebration of his first goal; this copy carries no agency caption.
caption.es: Messi a caballito de Ronaldinho en el Camp Nou, temporada 2004–05. Publicada habitualmente como el festejo de su primer gol; esta copia no trae epígrafe de agencia.

alt.en: A teenage Lionel Messi rides on Ronaldinho’s back, one arm raised and laughing, both in Barcelona’s blue and claret, with a blurred Camp Nou crowd behind.
alt.es: Un Lionel Messi adolescente va a caballito de Ronaldinho, con un brazo en alto y riendo, los dos de azulgrana, con la tribuna del Camp Nou desenfocada detrás.

photos.notes: Identification rests on the kit season, the pairing with Ronaldinho, the white opponents and the stadium. High confidence, not confirmed against an agency caption, so the public caption says so. A grain filter has been added by an editor.

photos.notes: Published at the owner’s instruction of 7 October 2026 that every supplied image be used; the caption states what the image is. Earlier reason for holding it: The framing, focus and colour look like a modern staged image (a film or advertising re-enactment with a child actor), not a 1990s family or club photograph. It cannot be presented as a photograph of Messi as a child until its origin is known. If the owner can name the source and it is a genuine childhood photograph, set status to "approved", slot to "beginning-main", and add a caption.

alt.es: Lionel Messi se ríe con los ojos casi cerrados mientras sostiene un gran trofeo plateado, con la camiseta rosa de Inter Miami.

photos.tentativeIdentity: Messi sliding on his knees with an arm raised; Alexis Mac Allister (20) and Julián Álvarez (9) running to him; a France player behind.
photos.verifiedEvent: World Cup final, Argentina v France, Lusail Stadium, 18 December 2022, during the match. Verified from the opponent, the team-mates’ numbers and the stadium boards.

caption.es: Final del Mundial, Lusail, 18 de diciembre de 2022. Durante el partido, cuando nadie sabía cómo iba a terminar.

alt.es: Lionel Messi se desliza por el césped sobre una rodilla, con el brazo derecho en alto; dos compañeros corren hacia él y la tribuna está de pie.

photos.verifiedEvent: Not the night of the final. The shirt carries the third star and the champions’ badge, which Argentina wore only after December 2022. Date, place and the other people are not identified.

caption.en: After Qatar. An embrace in the shirt with the third star and the world champions’ badge. The date and place have not been identified.

alt.es: Lionel Messi sonríe con calidez, con un brazo tatuado sobre la espalda de un hombre canoso que está de espaldas a la cámara.
